figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. Characterization of the trans-CMeT CalH’. A) LC-MS EIC
chromatograms of the products from (A) the in vitro enzymatic
reactions with CalA’ and CalD’’ in the absence of CalH’ and B) the in

SNAC (15) and the deduced structure of 16.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 6
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 6. Structural analysis of the trans-CMeT CalH’. A) Comparison
of the overall structures and SAM binding sites of CalH’ (green, PDB
ID: 7DMB) and PsoF-MT (blue, PDB ID: 6KJI). SAH is modeled as
yellow sticks and pink sticks in CalH’ and PsoF-MT, respectively.
B) Cartoon and surface views of ACP docked to CalH’ around the
positively charged region on the entrance of the active site pocket.
